Im lost in life but at the same time im not, its like i know what i want, but at the same time i want it ina different way. Peace, freedom. No worries about money. As much as i hate to say it myself but the real goal is living freely to have the choices you want to do and really accept it. Thats my problem. I cant fully enjoy something yet. Sometimes i neex to take a time for myself just me. And this music. It really represents my whole persona/mind. So much going on yet one steady bpm, not too noisy yet not too quiet. Its perfection. For days that i can just sitback and give myself a moment. Thank you for posting this. Still realizing about my life but thus music makes it easier.

It feels just like you wrote down my own story. You're right. Setting goals for freedom is good. However, you must not lose sight of the present. The more you do so, the more miserable it becomes. As a result, you end up clinging even more to that mirage-like freedom. It amounts to eating away at yourself. While you cherish the feeling of a future where you are living freely, do not think about anything else; just stay in the present, immerse yourself, and live like flowing water. If you haven't read the book *The Power of Now: A Guide to Spiritual Enlightenment* by Eckhart Tolle, I highly recommend you do.

Also, reading your comment made me realize something. The feeling I capture when creating content is conveyed to the listeners as well. The life you desire will become reality, with only a time lag, so please do not deny the present and try to live like flowing water.
@deeparchive-music you took my words right of my mouth haha. But wise words indeed bro, i dont know the quote but it was from bruce lee. He also talked about water in a different way.
